bio: Claire Marie Valdez (born October 12, 1989) is an American politician who is the U.S. Representative-elect for New York's 7th congressional district. A member of the Democratic Party and the Democratic Socialists of America, Valdez has served as a member of the New York State Assembly for the 37th district since 2025, representing part of Queens.
offices: Member of the New York State Assembly (2025–present)
